purpose: Record intentional architectural improvements, deferred enhancements, and future evolution points so that Factory memory is preserved.

entries.title: Structured Source Asset References
entries.current_state: Source assets are stored as simple strings such as knowledge_asset or financial_outcome_asset.
entries.future_state: Source assets should include asset_type, asset_id, version, certification_status, and path.
entries.business_benefit: Improves trust by making every advisor or decision output traceable to exact upstream assets.
entries.technical_benefit: Supports version lineage, auditability, and safer downstream consumption.
entries.reason_deferred: String references are sufficient for Copay v1 and GOLD validation.
entries.notes: Upgrade source_assets arrays across AIA and DIA first.

entries.title: Evidence-backed Decision Readiness
entries.current_state: Decision readiness is stored as static values such as COMPLETE and READY.
entries.future_state: Decision readiness should be computed from upstream asset certifications and verification results.
entries.business_benefit: Improves confidence that a customer is actually ready to decide.
entries.technical_benefit: Reduces hardcoding and makes readiness auditable.
entries.trigger: After Financial Outcome and Advisor Intelligence assets stabilize across multiple concepts.
entries.reason_deferred: Static readiness was sufficient for DIA v1.
entries.notes: DecisionReadiness may evolve into evidence-backed sub-objects.

entries.title: FOA to DIA Numeric Integration
entries.future_state: DIA should consume actual numbers from Financial Outcome Assets such as customer_pays, insurer_pays, and shock_level.
entries.business_benefit: Makes decision support more concrete and useful for customers and advisors.
entries.technical_benefit: Improves cross-asset consistency and reduces duplicate financial explanations.
entries.trigger: When financial simulations become dynamic or multiple scenarios exist.
entries.reason_deferred: DIA v1 only needed to prove the decision intelligence structure.
entries.notes: Should pull actual FOA fields instead of static text.

entries.title: Advisor Confidence Scoring
entries.current_state: Advisor confidence is represented by boolean readiness flags.
entries.future_state: Advisor confidence should include measurable scores for explanation readiness, objection handling, comparison ability, and documentation readiness.
entries.business_benefit: Helps train and support advisors more effectively.
entries.technical_benefit: Allows AIA quality to be measured across concepts.
entries.trigger: When Advisor Intelligence expands beyond Copay into several concepts.
entries.reason_deferred: Boolean flags were enough for AIA v1.
entries.notes: Can later feed advisor training or certification modules.

entries.title: Shared Infrastructure Expansion
entries.current_state: Shared infrastructure currently includes asset_normalizer.py only.
entries.future_state: Expand shared infrastructure with asset_registry.py, metadata.py, ids.py, hashing.py, file_utils.py, and certification_utils.py.
entries.business_benefit: Improves reliability as the Factory scales.
entries.trigger: Before Motor domain or before adding many new departments.
entries.reason_deferred: Current shared layer is sufficient for Health/Copay validation.
entries.notes: Asset Normalizer was introduced after schema variation caused GCP failure.

entries.title: Knowledge Family Registry
entries.current_state: Knowledge families are understood conceptually but not registered formally.
entries.future_state: Create a registry for product, regulatory, industry, glossary, advisor reality, behavioural, medical, taxation, and investment knowledge families.
entries.business_benefit: Allows PolicyScna to incorporate new knowledge sources without redesign.
entries.trigger: Before second insurance domain or before regulatory knowledge integration.
entries.reason_deferred: Current Health/Copay pipeline does not require multiple formal knowledge families.
entries.notes: Important for IRDAI, IC38, glossary, taxation, and life insurance expansion.

entries.title: Department Completion Automation
entries.current_state: Department completeness is checked manually through runs and GCP audits.
entries.future_state: Automate department completeness checks for manufacturing, certification, discovery, and downstream consumption.
entries.business_benefit: Reduces risk of hidden incomplete departments.
entries.technical_benefit: Standardizes acceptance criteria across all departments.
entries.trigger: After all current departments follow the standard pattern.
entries.reason_deferred: Manual checks are sufficient during early GMVS.
entries.notes: Lesson: a department is not complete until GCP can discover it.

entries.title: Cross-Concept GMVS
entries.current_state: Copay achieved GOLD, proving the pipeline once.
entries.future_state: Validate the same pipeline against multiple concepts such as Waiting Period, PED, Room Rent, Restoration, and Deductible.
entries.business_benefit: Proves the Factory can scale beyond one concept.
entries.technical_benefit: Measures architecture reuse and exposes concept-specific assumptions.
entries.trigger: Immediately after first GOLD Golden Concept Package.
entries.reason_deferred: Required first GOLD concept before cross-concept validation.
entries.notes: Factory itself recommended this as the next action.

entries.title: Customer Understanding Index
entries.current_state: Concept maturity is measured internally by GCP.
entries.future_state: Create a customer-facing or product-level Understanding Index that measures likely customer comprehension and surprise risk.
entries.business_benefit: Helps insurers, advisors, and regulators measure awareness instead of only complaints.
entries.technical_benefit: Aggregates knowledge, understanding, mental model, financial shock, and decision readiness scores.
entries.reason_deferred: Requires enough concepts and validation data.
entries.notes: Potential future differentiator for insurers and regulators.

entries.title: Regulatory Knowledge Family
entries.current_state: Regulatory knowledge is recognized as important but not integrated as a first-class knowledge family.
entries.future_state: Treat IRDAI regulations, master circulars, advisories, FAQs, and regulatory updates as first-class knowledge assets.
entries.business_benefit: Improves compliance-aware explanations and decision support.
entries.technical_benefit: Adds regulatory traceability to concepts affected by rules and circulars.
entries.trigger: Before Life Insurance expansion or before regulatory-heavy concepts.
entries.reason_deferred: Not required for Copay GOLD validation.
entries.notes: Examples include no maximum entry age and special surrender value rules.
